acceptance_predicates.description: Codex receives only the selected loopback endpoint, model, and invocation credential from the bound cli2key launch.
Authentication, model, bridge, endpoint, or sidecar failure never falls back to another provider or ambient Codex defaults.
The credential reaches only the final child boundary and remains absent from ordinary evidence and diagnostics.
The benchmark invokes Codex directly and never nests another agent behind Codex app-server.
